title: Shiseido sells off 30-year-old Chinese beauty brand Aupres
summary: Ownership of Shiseido Liyuan Cosmetics, which makes the skin care, sun care and make-up brand Aupres exclusively for the Chinese market, will transfer to a new consortium led by IDG Capital

extraction.key_fact: 시세이도가 중국 전용 브랜드 오프레를 IDG 캐피털이 이끄는 컨소시엄에 넘긴다.
